customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be among the best in the market, offering excellent value for money with transparent pricing. The installation process receives positive feedback, with one customer noting it's very simple to set up. Moreover, the purifier performs reliably, with one customer mentioning it works well with any type of water, and customers appreciate its premium appearance and sweet-tasting output. Additionally, the water quality is consistently good, with one customer specifically noting improved TDS levels, and the service receives praise for its professional and consumer-friendly approach.

reviews.author: Dada Khalandar
reviews.title: Impressive TDS reduction and hassle-free ownership!
reviews.body: Outstanding performance and total value for money! Highly impressed with the Native M1 by Urban Company. Our input water TDS was extremely high at 1190, and this purifier brought it right down to a clean 134. The promised 2-year zero filter change feature makes it an absolute game-changer—no maintenance hassle for two full years. Delicious, clean drinking water. Highly recommended!
